# RankList (chat block)

• RankList(title (static), items (static), subtitle? (static), confirmLabel? (static))
  - Description: A drag-to-reorder ranked list.
  - title: Card title, e.g. "Your priorities".
  - items: The things to rank, in the proposed order.
  - subtitle: Line under the title. Defaults to "Top of the list gets the best hours."
  - confirmLabel: Primary button text. Defaults to "Use this order".

RankList(title, items, subtitle?, confirmLabel?) — a short list (3-7 strings) the user drags into priority order. Use it to let the user rank or prioritise before you plan. Event: use_order {items} with the items in the user's order (plan from that). Example: card = RankList("Your priorities", ["Design review", "Client feedback session", "Project kickoff", "Workout"])
